title: Flood Premiums Billed in Installments or Not Billed at All: Summit Reserve Current Premium
content:
At a review of the flood insurance bills of a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, the current flood premium is established on a pay-plan or carry-forward basis according to how many of the flood bills of the review are paid or received. The flood bills of the review are the flood insurance bills on file for the reserve received within the twelve months before the review — no later than the review date and fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.

| Paid or received flood bills of the review | Basis | Current flood premium |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | Pay-plan basis | The sum of the billed amounts of those paid and received bills, because a policy billed in installments costs the sum of its installments |
| None | Carry-forward basis | The annual flood premium already on file |
| Exactly one | — | Not set by this rule |

Withdrawn bills are neither paid nor received and are not added in.

**Hypothetical file.** Four flood bills of the review — three paid at 310.00 and one received at 310.00 — give a current flood premium of 1,240.00 on the pay-plan basis. A file whose only flood bills of the review are withdrawn carries forward the annual flood premium on file, say 1,150.00.
